test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Why I Am a Hindu’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shashi Tharoor.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A former** international civil servant, diplomat, bureaucrat, politician, writer, and public intellectua**l from India, Shashi Tharoor has represented **Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala**, in the **legislature since 2009.**
 
• He is the** Chairman of the Standing Committee on Chemicals and Fertilizers.**
 
• Shashi Tharoor published the book **Why I Am a Hindu in 2018**.
 
• Tharoor clarifies his personal religious beliefs while writing about the **history of Hinduism and its fundamental principles, **as well as related **socio-cultural changes** in India.
 
• His other works include An** Era of Darkness, Pax Indica, Tharoorosaurus, and The Paradoxical Prime Minister. ​**
